verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic time-zone detection, slot display in the invitee's time zone, or DST handling on SavvyCal booking pages. The only time-zone mention covers workflow message variables (inserting the meeting time in the guest's own time zone into reminders). That is a different feature from how slots are displayed on the booking page, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
